what: IQ3_S #2514 port gate at 262K: wide vs PER_MAX register decode top-k on gfx1100

port.commit: ed3606a6 (refresh-0145): qsa top-k - the 262K-context decode window can take the PER_MAX register kernel (#2514 port, opt-in STRATA_TOPK_DECODE_REG=1)
port.change: src/kernels/cuda/qsa_select.cu: under __HIPCC__, fit = TK_T * ((counted || topk_decode_reg) ? TK_PER_MAX : TK_PER); the env is default OFF (the PR defaults it on; the fork keeps experiments opt-in until the gate)
port.dispatch_finding: the PR's premise does not hold on 0.1.45: reach > fit already goes to the WIDE kernel (campaign3 / 82922f55), not the one-CTA ref; 131K decode takes the register kernel either way (32,770 <= 33,792). The port changes only the 262K tier: 65,538 blocks, wide -> register<PER_MAX>
port.binary: build-0145/strata rebuilt in place, sha256 b0d443f9efc3ab4abd6e6b21bc0f195e897575c9ff4385cc92ee1501dcea8351; the STRATA_VERSION string stays 0.1.45-8eb3e85d (baked at configure time) - the commit is the provenance
port.production_impact: behavior-neutral at the configured 131072 context (same dispatch both ways); the running 8081 process was restarted onto this binary by the window trap, health ok, engine stamp unchanged

window.production: stopped and restored healthy after ~24 s

parity.meaning: same ids under both dispatches - the port is exact by construction

cells.config: 261,888-token prompt, --max-context 262144, 64 new tokens, production args/env; arms: unset (wide) vs STRATA_TOPK_DECODE_REG=1 (register)
cells.first_pair_note: the +4.45% is the first base cell running cold (54.11); once warm both arms sit at ~56.5 - not a kernel effect

verdict.gate: median ms/round <= -3% + same ids + no pair > +2%
verdict.disposition: the port stays in the tree as a dormant opt-in (default OFF, same ids, parity-tested); no config change; a 262K-context run may set STRATA_TOPK_DECODE_REG=1 for the register dispatch, but on this card the wide kernel is already equivalent
